focused.instrumentation: Original complete pure function bodies forwarded. No per-generator, Schema or function-stack observer. Nested whole-owner timers subtract selected children. Branch counters use existing local values after original private-map lookups. Half the pairs disable numeric leaf timers. All validation and ordering retained; envelopes remain elapsed measurements, not exclusive CPU or proven savings.

methodology.full: Forwarding proxies around original authored generator factories and iterator next/throw/return. Original Result.gen and selected original Schema factories/parsers and Effect.fn construction are retained. Synchronous nested timers subtract measured children; no suspended wait is timed as a generator body. These elapsed envelopes include observer cost and preemption and are not exclusive CPU. Half the pairs disable numeric leaf timers but keep wrappers. No production source or checks changed.
methodology.meaning: Synchronous elapsed envelopes are neither exclusive CPU attribution nor measured savings. Full probe Result.gen self time includes iterator-proxy/timer scaffolding outside body timers. All generator body time includes uninstrumented required business/encoding/driver work. No native leaf subtraction is performed. Schema Effect parsers cover immediate invocation only. Schema identity hints name the first factory, not all consumers of a shared schema. Source files unchanged; test-only forwarding observers can alter stack shape and JIT behavior.
methodology.calibration: Balanced observed/off assignments within each process; Windows counter quantization and small groups prevent subtracting observer differences from owner envelopes. Light lane removes deep clocks but retains numeric branch/call counters and forwarding wrappers.
